title: Cranial Capacity Comparison
text: Modern human brains average about 1400 cc. Chimpanzee brains average about 350-400 cc. If Australopithecus had about 450 cc but was already walking upright, what does this tell us about the sequence of evolutionary changes?

title: Evidence for Bipedalism
text: Features indicating bipedalism include: foramen magnum position (underneath skull), S-curved spine, bowl-shaped pelvis, and angle of femur (thigh bone). Australopithecus had these features despite having a small brain, telling us which trait evolved first.
